questions.question: Three of the four numbers are alike in a certain way and one is different. Pick the odd number out.

questions.question: A contractor planned to finish a work in 12 days and employed a certain number of men. However, 6 of them remained absent from the very first day. The rest could finish the work in 20 days. The number of men originally employed were:
questions.solution:
Let Number of Men employed = X

Number of men remaining to work = X – 6

Total work = Men working × number of days

12 × X = (X – 6) × 20

8X = 120

X = 15

Hence Number of men originally employed were 15.

questions.question: Three of the following four letter-clusters are alike in a certain way and one is different. Pick the odd one out.
questions.solution:
Pattern followed is:

N + 2 = P, P + 2 = R, R + 2 = T

J + 3 = M, M + 3 = P, P + 3 = S

W - 1 = V, V - 1 = U, U - 2 = S

D + 1 = E, E + 1 = F, F + 1 = G

Only WVUS non positive and nonuniform.

Hence WVUS is the odd among the given options.

questions.question:
Two statements are followed by three conclusions numbered I, II and III. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they do not conform to real-world knowledge, decide which of the conclusion(s) logically follows/follow from the statements.

**Statements: **

All knives are instruments.

Some cutters are knives.

**Conclusions: **

I. Some cutters are instruments.

II. All knives are cutters.

III. Some knives are not instruments.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/25a87aecd09c194dfb03c34437075e2fbfa33bdd4bba5a2b1b7ca5234df31655.png] 

I. Some cutters are instruments → True.

II. All knives are cutters → False (It is possible but not definite)

III. Some knives are not instruments → False.

Hence, only conclusion I follows.

questions.question:

questions.solution:
Pattern followed is:

5 × (5 + 2) = 35

so, 35: 5

Similarly,

7 × (7 + 2) = 63

so, 63: 7

Hence 63 : 7 is answer.

questions.question:
Which of the two signs should be interchanged in the following equation to make the given value correct?

15 + 5 - 10 × 6 ÷ 12 = 6
questions.solution:
Interchanging - and ÷

15 + 5 div 10 times 6 - 12 = 15 + frac{{5 times 6}}{{10}} - 12

**15 + 3 - 12 = 6**

Interchanging + and ÷

15 ÷ 5 – 10 × 6 + 12 = 3 - 60 + 12

15 – 60 ≠ 6

Interchanging + and ×

15 times 5 - 10 + 6 div 12 = 75 - 10 + (1)/(2)

65 + (1)/(2) ne 6

Interchanging + and -

15 - 5 + 10 × 6 ÷ 12 = 15 - 5 + 5

15 – 5 ≠ 6

Hence by interchanging - and ÷ we get the correct equation.

questions.question:
Choose the set of numbers that is similar to the following set.

(4, 12, 16)
questions.solution:
The pattern followed is:

3rd number - 1st number = 2nd number(Middle no.)

(4, 12, 16)

16 - 4 = 12

Similarly,

(64, 36, 100)

100 - 64 = 36

Hence (64, 36, 100) is the answer.
